Import data set
```{r}
library(readxl)
lending_club_loan <- read_excel("lending_club_loan_two.xlsx")
View(lending_club_loan)
```

Name all variables
# Loan status : 0 represents Charged Off
#               1 represents Fully Paid
```{r}
amnt <- lending_club_loan$loan_amnt            # Numerical
term <- lending_club_loan$`term(months)`       # Classical
int <- lending_club_loan$`int_rate(%)`         # Numerical
intallment <- lending_club_loan$installment    # Numerical
grade <- lending_club_loan$grade               # Classical
subgrade <- lending_club_loan$sub_grade        # Classical
emplength <- lending_club_loan$`emp_length(years)`   # Numerical
inc <- lending_club_loan$annual_inc                  # Numerical
veri <- lending_club_loan$verification_status        # Classical
status <- lending_club_loan$loan_status              # Classical(Response variable)


loan_to_income <- amnt / (inc + 1)
installment_to_income <- lending_club_loan$installment / ((inc / 12) + 1)
```

Change the format of "emp_length(years)"
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
# 步骤 1 & 2: 选择原始工龄列并确保是字符串 (R 中数据框列通常已经是合适的类型)
# 步骤 3: 去除非数字字符
# 步骤 4: 把空字符串变成 '0'
# 步骤 5: 转换成浮点数 (R 中的 numeric 类型)

# Steps 1 & 2: Select the original seniority column and ensure it is a string (dataframe columns in R are usually already of the appropriate type)

# Step 3: Remove non-numeric characters

# Step 4: Convert empty strings to '0'

# Step 5: Convert to floating-point number (numeric type in R)
```{r}
clean <- lending_club_loan %>%
  
  # Python: .str.replace(r'[^0-9]', '', regex=True)
  # R: stringr::str_replace_all()
  mutate(emplength_clean = str_replace_all(
    string = as.character(emplength), # 确保是字符串
    pattern = "[^0-9]",                      # 正则表达式：匹配非数字字符
    replacement = ""                         # 替换成空字符串
  )) %>%
  # Python: .replace('', '0')
  # R: ifelse() 或 dplyr::na_if() 配合 mutate
  mutate(emplength_clean = ifelse(
    emplength_clean == "",
    "0",
    emplength_clean
  )) %>%
  # Python: .astype(float)
  # R: as.numeric()
  mutate(emplength_clean = as.numeric(emplength_clean))
```

```{r}
# 1. 打印标题
cat("--- 雇佣年限清洗结果验证 ---\n")

# 2. 打印 emp_length_years 和 emp_length_clean 这两列的前 10 行
# Python: print(df[['emp_length(years)', 'emplength_clean']].head(10))
clean %>%
  select(`emp_length(years)`, emplength_clean)%>%
  head(10)

# 3. 打印清洗后列的数据类型
# Python: print(f"\n清洗后的 'emp_length_clean' 列的数据类型是: {df['emp_length_clean'].dtype}")
cat("\n清洗后的 'emplength_clean' 列的数据类型是:",
    class(clean$emplength_clean),
    "\n")


# --- 打印完整的 DataFrame (包括 emp_length_clean) ---

# 4. 打印完整数据框的前 5 行
# Python: print(df.head(5))
cat("--- 完整的 DataFrame (包括 emp_length_clean) ---\n")
clean %>%
  head(5)
```

Plot gg-plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(clean, aes(x = loan_status, y = `int_rate(%)`)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(7, 20)) +

  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", 
               color = "darkblue", # 设置边框为深蓝色
               alpha = 0.8) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between status and int_rate",
    x = "status",
    y = "int_rate"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(clean, aes(x = loan_status, y = annual_inc)) +
  geom_boxplot() +

  # 关键改进：使用小提琴图显示完整分布
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) + 
  
  # 强烈建议：同时进行对数缩放，让小提琴的形状更清晰
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log",           # 指定使用自然对数变换
    labels = scales::comma,  # 保持标签易读
    name = "Annual Income(Natural logarithmic scale)" # 修改轴标签
  ) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "skyblue",  
    color = "navy"
  ) +
  
labs(
    title = "Loan status and annual income distribution (logarithmic operation on annual income)",
    x = "status",
    fill = "贷款状态"
  ) 
  
  theme_minimal()
```

###### Catagorical Variables ######
```{r}
# 1. 计算频数 (Count)
counts <- table(clean$`term(months)`)
print(counts)

# 2. 计算比例 (Proportion)
proportions <- prop.table(counts)
print(proportions)

# 3. 计算百分比
percentages <- proportions * 100
print(percentages)
```
